headline: US Treasury Yields Rise as Investors Eye 6% Benchmark Threshold
summary: Fixed-income investors and asset managers including Fidelity and Pimco warned that US Treasury yields could climb toward 6% as debt supply pressures mount.
why: US Treasury yields set borrowing cost baselines globally for consumer credit, mortgages, and corporate bonds.

impacts.name: US 10-Year Treasury Yield
impacts.why: Growing US sovereign debt issuance and inflation concerns pushed yields upward.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Concerns over expanding government deficit spending pushed long-term Treasury yields toward new highs.
